headline: Today's top AI story: FBI links $6.3 billion Binance crypto heist to North Korean hackers
bullets: FBI links $6.3 billion Binance crypto heist to North Korean hackers
Binance Allows Customers to Resume Withdrawals, Sees $5.8 Billion Net Outflow
Brazilian lawyers busted for attempting to manipulate court's AI with prompt injection hidden in filing — court's AI flags hidden text that demanded superficial legal scrutiny, lawyers fined $16,000
Easy to forget that many people have no idea that local AI exists…..at all.
Saudi Aramco acquires a 49% stake in AI startup Humain, contributing ~$2.6B in cash in 2026 plus AI, compute, and digital assets; Saudi Arabia's PIF retains 51% (Dean Takahashi/GamesBeat)
